opportunities.description: Utah’s child care assistance program can help eligible families pay all or part of child care costs. Applicants must generally be a parent or legal caregiver, meet income rules, and work at least 15 hours a week (two-parent rules differ). Apply through myCase at jobs.utah.gov/mycase or with help at an employment center (1-866-435-7414).
opportunities.notes: Income limits and other rules are set by DWS and can change. The official income table is published separately (Table 4). This is an application program, not a calculator. mydoorway.utah.gov/child-care-assistance/ had an SSL error in this environment; use the DWS page and myCase instead. Claude status note: Active; use the official Table 4 for limits.
